entities.name: Rodrigo Leão
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rodrigo Costa Leão Muñoz Miguez, known professionally as Rodrigo Leão, is a Portuguese musician and songwriter. He became known in the 1980s as a member of the Portuguese groups Sétima Legião and Madredeus. In the 1990s, Leão launched his career as a solo artist, with multiple albums reaching number-one in the Portuguese album charts.
